# notion

## Plugin reference

- Description: Notion OAuth provider (scaffold). Adds the Notion row to the Accounts pane, set up there with the generic OAuth client steps (console → redirect URI → client id + secret → connect), and registers the credentials config. Surfaces in Accounts pane; end-to-end smoke not yet validated.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `Auth.Provider` "Notion"
    - `ConfigV2.WebRegister` "auth-notion"
  - Uses:
    - `auth.Auth`
    - `config_v2.ConfigV2`
- Server:
  - Contributes: `ConfigV2.Register` "auth-notion"
  - Uses: `config_v2.ConfigV2`
- Central:
  - Uses:
    - `auth.registerAuthProvider`
    - `fields/secret/config.readSecretConfig`
- Shared:
  - Exports (values): `notionAuthConfig`
